changes.to: RIVR's product page (checked 2026-11-17): wheeled-legged doorstep delivery robot that rides sidewalks and bike lanes, climbs stairs and opens gates; more than 30 kg payload, up to 14 km/h (3.89 m/s) when needed, over 30 km range with a 2-3 h recharge, and van-dispensed delivery mode. Mass, dimensions and battery capacity are not published.
